rules.statement: A right of servitude of light and air cannot be acquired by prescription through mere enjoyment, i.e., the mere fact that a neighbor has not built on their land for any length of time.
rules.supporting_quote: "A right of servitude of light and air cannot be acquired by prescription by mere enjoyment, i.e., by the mere fact that the neighbour has not built on his land for any length of time. Pillay v. Fernando (1912) 14 N. L. R. 13S not followed."
